title: George Synkellos, Ecloga chronographica (Ἐκλογὴ χρονογραφίας; «Избранная хронография» Георгия Синкелла)
author: George Synkellos
size: Mosshammer c. 470 Teubner pp., est. 150k words
edition: Dindorf, CSHB 1829 (public domain). Mosshammer, Teubner 1984 (in copyright)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia lists only the medieval Slavonic abridgement (ed. Totomanova 2008) and studies. No modern Russian
en_evidence: W. Adler & P. Tuffin, The Chronography of George Synkellos (OUP 2002), listed on ru.wikipedia
value: The largest storehouse of Berossus, Manetho, Africanus, Eusebius, Panodorus, Annianus and the 1 Enoch fragments. Indispensable for Near Eastern, Egyptian, Jewish and Hellenistic chronology.
ai_feasibility: High: regular learned Greek. King-lists and tables need structured handling and automated numeral checks
pilot_unit: The Egyptian dynasties (Manetho via Africanus/Eusebius) or the Alexander–Diadochi section, c. 30 Teubner pp.
